feeds.title: Slate
feeds.description: Slate Magazine, founded in 1996 by Michael Kinsley, is an influential online publication that offers insightful commentary and analysis on current affairs, politics, and culture in the United States. Managed by The Slate Group since 2008, Slate has built a reputation for its distinctive and often contrarian viewpoints, aiming to surprise readers with its conclusions and the unique ways it reaches them. The editorial team is led by Hillary Frey as editor-in-chief, with notable contributors such as Anne Applebaum and John Dickerson...
